problem:
A particle moves along a straight line relative to a fixed origin $O$ with acceleration, measured in ${\text{m/s}}^{2},$ given by the function $a(t)=6{t}^{2}-12{t}^{5}+4,$ where $t$ is the time in seconds. Find the speed of the particle at the moment $t=2\,\text{s}$ given that the particle has velocity $v=3\,\text{m/s}$ when $t=0\,\text{s}.$

The speed at the moment $t=2\,\text{s}$ is
{{field-1}} $\text{m/s}.$
